title: Occupational Therapists
description: Assess, plan, and organize rehabilitative programs that help build or restore vocational, homemaking, and daily living skills, as well as general independence, to persons with disabilities or developmental delays. Use therapeutic techniques, adapt the individual's environment, teach skills, and modify specific tasks that present barriers to the individual.

tasks.text: Test and evaluate patients' physical and mental abilities and analyze medical data to determine realistic rehabilitation goals for patients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment goals need clinical accountability and context

dwas.name: Evaluate patient functioning, capabilities, or health.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Plan, organize, and conduct occupational therapy programs in hospital, institutional, or community settings to help rehabilitate persons with disabilities because of illness, injury or psychological or developmental problems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafts health program design; implementation and buy-in human

dwas.name: Design public or employee health programs.
Direct healthcare delivery programs.

tasks.text: Plan and implement programs and social activities to help patients learn work or school skills and adjust to handicaps.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Draft non-medical plans; clinician validates and owns

dwas.name: Develop treatment plans that use non-medical therapies.

tasks.text: Select activities that will help individuals learn work and life-management skills within limits of their mental or physical capabilities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Draft non-medical plans; clinician validates and owns

dwas.name: Develop treatment plans that use non-medical therapies.

tasks.text: Evaluate patients' progress and prepare reports that detail progress.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Summarize diagnostic and care activities into reports

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.
Prepare reports summarizing patient diagnostic or care activities.

tasks.text: Train caregivers in providing for the needs of a patient during and after therapy.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Caregiver training needs live modeling and supervision

dwas.name: Train caregivers or other non-medical personnel.

tasks.text: Lay out materials such as puzzles, scissors and eating utensils for use in therapy, and clean and repair these tools after therapy sessions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assembly of medical supplies

dwas.name: Clean medical equipment or facilities.
Prepare medical supplies or equipment for use.

tasks.text: Consult with rehabilitation team to select activity programs or coordinate occupational therapy with other therapeutic activities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Design and create, or requisition, special supplies and equipment, such as splints, braces, and computer-aided adaptive equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI assists concepts; device design requires regulatory and physical testing

dwas.name: Design medical devices or appliances.
Fabricate medical devices.

tasks.text: Recommend changes in patients' work or living environments, consistent with their needs and capabilities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Wellness advice needs tailoring and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Provide health and wellness advice to patients, program participants, or caregivers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Develop and participate in health promotion programs, group activities, or discussions to promote client health, facilitate social adjustment, alleviate stress, and prevent physical or mental disability.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafts health program design; implementation and buy-in human

dwas.name: Design public or employee health programs.

tasks.text: Provide training and supervision in therapy techniques and objectives for students or nurses and other medical staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.
Supervise patient care personnel.

tasks.text: Help clients improve decision making, abstract reasoning, memory, sequencing, coordination, and perceptual skills, using computer programs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Coordinating real-world daily life details with client

dwas.name: Assist clients in handling details of daily life.
Assist patients with daily activities.

tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Advise on health risks in the workplace or on health-related transition to retirement.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafts guidance; community trust and liability human

dwas.name: Advise communities or institutions regarding health or safety issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Provide patients with assistance in locating or holding jobs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Encouraging life-skill development is relational, sustained human work

dwas.name: Encourage patients or clients to develop life skills.

emerging_tasks.task: Recommend adaptive equipment to individuals to increase independence in daily living activities.
